info.title: Prank Encounters - Scherzi da brivido
info.synopsis: Le paure più mostruose incontrano momenti spassosissimi in queste candid camera in cui persone reali diventano le protagoniste di horror estremi.

seasons.plot: He fights monsters on "Stranger Things," but here Gaten Matarazzo brings the scares as the host of his own prank show.

episodes.name: Teddy Scare
episodes.plot: One worker has a babysitting gig, while another stops by to collect toys for charity. But a certain evil teddy bear doesn't want to be collected.

translations.value: One worker has a babysitting gig, while another stops by to collect toys for charity. But a certain evil teddy bear doesn't want to be collected.

episodes.name: End of the Road
episodes.plot: Temps hired to investigate frequent accidents on an isolated stretch of road find themselves in an angry mama monster’s unhappy hunting ground.

translations.value: Temps hired to investigate frequent accidents on an isolated stretch of road find themselves in an angry mama monster’s unhappy hunting ground.

episodes.name: Face Fears
episodes.plot: One temp assists a patient in post-op recovery as another helps a sleuth find a missing woman. Cue a shocking reveal and an emergency call to nowhere.

translations.value: One temp assists a patient in post-op recovery as another helps a sleuth find a missing woman. Cue a shocking reveal and an emergency call to nowhere.

episodes.name: Urgent Scare
episodes.plot: When an ailing ex-astronaut checks into a night clinic, two women find themselves locked in a cosmic battle with a gruesome souvenir from space.

translations.value: When an ailing ex-astronaut checks into a night clinic, two women find themselves locked in a cosmic battle with a gruesome souvenir from space.

episodes.name: Camp Scarecrow
episodes.plot: Two unsuspecting strangers try to rebrand a shuttered summer camp. But a crazed custodian and a homicidal scarecrow crash their brainstorming session.

translations.value: Two unsuspecting strangers try to rebrand a shuttered summer camp. But a crazed custodian and a homicidal scarecrow crash their brainstorming session.

episodes.name: Storage War of the Worlds
episodes.plot: An electrical outage in a top-secret government warehouse triggers a shutdown and releases a hostile alien on the terrified staff. Don’t zap him!

translations.value: An electrical outage in a top-secret government warehouse triggers a shutdown and releases a hostile alien on the terrified staff. Don’t zap him!

episodes.name: Fright at the Museum
episodes.plot: An Egyptian sarcophagus arrives at the Gaten Museum. When an assistant decodes its hieroglyphics, an ancient curse activates -- and yikes, snakes!

translations.value: An Egyptian sarcophagus arrives at the Gaten Museum. When an assistant decodes its hieroglyphics, an ancient curse activates -- and yikes, snakes!

episodes.name: Split Party
episodes.plot: Gaten and his hired hands attend a young fan’s birthday party. But the good times go south when the host serves up his killer cake.

translations.value: Gaten and his hired hands attend a young fan’s birthday party. But the good times go south when the host serves up his killer cake.

seasons.plot: Il presentatore Gaten Matarazzo ritorna con una nuova stagione di scherzi elaborati come case infestate da fantasmi o antichi cimiteri. Che spavento!

episodes.name: Queste mura possono parlare
episodes.plot: Due donne ignare lottano con gli inquietanti abitanti "passati" e presenti di un'enorme villa mentre la preparano per la vendita.

translations.value: Due donne ignare lottano con gli inquietanti abitanti "passati" e presenti di un'enorme villa mentre la preparano per la vendita.

episodes.name: L'anello mancante...
episodes.plot: Per fortuna questa pericolosa entità preistorica è conservata al sicuro in celle frigorifere... se dovesse scongelarsi sarebbe un bel guaio. Che entri in scena il calore!

episodes.name: La villa di Spider Man
episodes.plot: Mentre lavorano in una casa apparentemente infestata, l'aiutante di un disinfestatore e un'assistente personale sviluppano una paura più che comprensibile dei ragni.

translations.value: Mentre lavorano in una casa apparentemente infestata, l'aiutante di un disinfestatore e un'assistente personale sviluppano una paura più che comprensibile dei ragni.

episodes.name: Arma mentale
episodes.plot: Questo inventore ha davvero realizzato un dispositivo in grado di leggere nella mente delle persone? Certo che no... ma i suoi ingenui sostenitori non devono saperlo.

episodes.name: Nebbia paranormale
episodes.plot: Un selezionatore di frutta e un'assistente alle relazioni esterne cercano di sopravvivere a quella che pensano sia una nebbia mortale proveniente da un'altra dimensione.

episodes.plot: In questo sequel di un episodio della prima stagione, un chirurgo folle si aggira a piede libero mentre due stanchi lavoratori temporanei lo osservano terrorizzati.

translations.overview: Le paure più mostrose incontrano momenti spassosissimi in queste candid camera in cui persone reali diventano le protagoniste di horror estremi.
Monstrous frights meet hilarious reveals on this hidden-camera prank show as real people become the stars of their own full-blown horror movie.
